description: LLM cross-asset desk (SPY QQQ GLD TLT BTC-USD ETH-USD, 1-3 calls a day, 5-bar hold) with FinMem-style layered memory (working / episodic / semantic) and ExpeL-style lessons computed by code from its own settled trades only; lessons need 5 supporting trades, a better-than-baseline hit rate and out-of-sample confirmation before use, and expire. Paired with the no-memory control memory_desk_control.
output_character: daily long/short calls on six liquid ETFs and crypto, confidence 0.50-0.70, 3 x ATR20 code stop, 5-bar hold
public_data_sources: public daily price bars via gateway.price_history (complete bars only)
public news headlines passed by the Playground runner
the agent's own settled ledger records and their code-computed review facts
author: MarketMind (owner decision 2026-09-29)
